section.heading: Creation of the Frank D. Reeves Municipal Center TIF Area.

para.text: There is created a TIF area designated as the Frank D. Reeves Municipal Center TIF Area, which shall consist of Lot 0844 in Square 0204 and Air Rights Lot 7000 in Square 0204 as shown on the tax rolls of the District as maintained by the Office of Tax and Revenue.

As provided in § 2-1217.40bbbb, the Available Tax Increment from the Frank D. Reeves Municipal Center TIF Area shall be deposited in the Frank D. Reeves Municipal Center TIF Fund and may be used for the purposes set forth in § 2-1217.40bbbb.

The base year for determination of Available Sales Tax Revenues from locations within the Frank D. Reeves Municipal Center TIF Area shall be the tax year preceding the year in which this subpart becomes effective.

The base year for determination of Available Real Property Tax Revenues from properties within the Frank D. Reeves Municipal Center TIF Area shall be the tax year preceding the year in which this subpart becomes effective and the initial assessed value to be used in making the determination of Available Real Property Tax Revenues shall be the assessed value of each lot of taxable real property in the Frank D. Reeves Municipal Center TIF Area for the tax year preceding the tax year in which this subpart becomes effective.
The Frank D. Reeves Municipal Center TIF Area shall terminate on the earliest of:
The date on which the Bonds are paid in full or are defeased and are no longer outstanding; or
Five years after [August 13, 2026], if no Bonds are issued.
